matched.title: update_signer has no authorization check, so anyone can overwrite an existing signer

findings.title: update_signer has no authorization check, so anyone can overwrite an existing signer
findings.evidence: src/lib.rs:66 `fn update_signer(env: Env, signer: Signer) {` · src/lib.rs:69 `store_signer(&env, &signer_key, &signer_val, &signer_storage, true);`

failing_checks.title: Account authority changes
failing_checks.reason: update_signer has no require_auth. Anyone can overwrite an existing signer's key value, for example a Secp256r1 signer's public key, expiry or limits. The attacker then signs as that signer, which is an account takeover. add_signer, remove_signer and update_contract_code do require the wallet's own

failing_checks.title: Soroban contract checks
failing_checks.reason: This state-changing function has no require_auth. Signers are kept in persistent or temporary storage with TTL extension, so the storage and TTL parts hold. The missing auth on update_signer is the failure.

failing_checks.title: Caller authentication
failing_checks.reason: update_signer has no require_auth, unlike add_signer, remove_signer and update_contract_code. Anyone can overwrite an existing signer's key, limits and expiry.

failing_checks.title: Tenant isolation
failing_checks.reason: Any caller can modify another signer's record in the wallet because update_signer is unauthenticated. This is the same defect as the earlier finding.

failing_checks.title: Approvals fail closed
failing_checks.reason: __check_auth fails closed, but the signer-limit policy store can be rewritten by anyone through the unauthenticated update_signer. A signer's limits and expiry can be removed or replaced, so the gate is bypassable.

failing_checks.title: Controls outside the prompt
failing_checks.reason: update_signer has no require_auth, unlike add_signer and remove_signer. Anyone can overwrite an existing signer's limits and expiry, and can replace a signer's key with a different SignerVal. That lets them grant themselves admin rights.

failing_checks.title: Stated purpose versus behaviour
failing_checks.reason: The wallet is meant to enforce per-signer limits and admin-only signer management. update_signer bypasses that.
